title: United Airlines flight emergency: Unruly passenger hospitalized after being removed from plane from Tokyo, Japan to Chicago O'Hare

 Unruly passenger hospitalized after being removed from United Airlines flight from Japan to Chicago 
 An unruly passenger was hospitalized after being removed from a United Airlines flight from Tokyo, Japan to Chicago, Illinois, officials said. By ABC7 Chicago Digital Team Thursday, November 12, 2026 1:10AM Share CHICAGO (WLS) -- A man on a flight from Tokyo, Japan to Chicago was taken to a hospital after he had to be removed from the plane.
 A United Airlines flight declared an emergency for an unruly passenger Wednesday afternoon.

 Chicago police said a man was taken to a hospital for evaluation after the plane landed at O'Hare airport.
